description: This file is a PHPUnit test case for the UserDao class within the OrangeHRM admin plugin. It tests various methods related to user management, such as saving users, checking user existence, retrieving users and roles, and filtering employees by roles.

classes.name: UserDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing UserDao functionalities such as saving users, retrieving users, roles, checking user existence, and employee filtering.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes UserDao instance and prepares test fixtures before each test.

methods.name: getUserRole
methods.description: Helper method to fetch a UserRole entity by ID.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Helper method to fetch an Employee entity by employee number.

methods.name: testSaveSystemUser
methods.description: Tests saving a new User entity to the database.

methods.name: testIsExistingSystemUserForNonExistingUser
methods.description: Tests detection of a non-existing user.

methods.name: testIsExistingSystemUserForExistingUser
methods.description: Tests detection of an existing user.

methods.name: testIsExistingSystemUserForDeletedUser
methods.description: Tests detection for a deleted user.

methods.name: testIsExistingSystemUserForEmptyPasswordUser
methods.description: Tests detection for a user with an empty password.

methods.name: testGetSystemUser
methods.description: Retrieves a system user by ID and verifies credentials.

methods.name: testGetSystemUserForNonExistingId
methods.description: Verifies that retrieving a non-existent user returns null.

methods.name: testGetAssignableUserRoles
methods.description: Checks retrieval of assignable user roles.

methods.name: testGetSystemUserIdList
methods.description: Verifies fetching list of user IDs.

methods.name: testGetSystemUserIdListForOneActiveUser
methods.description: Verifies user ID list filtering for active users.

methods.name: testGetEmployeesByUserRole
methods.description: Tests filtering employees based on user roles.

methods.name: testUserStatusByUserName
methods.description: Checks if a username exists in the system.
